title: e-Shram registration (unorganised / gig workers)
keywords: e-shram eshram registration unorganised gig platform worker card UAN accident insurance ई-श्रम पंजीकरण
summary: National database of unorganised workers. Registration is free. Age 16-59, not an EPFO/ESIC member and not an income-tax payer. Gives an e-Shram card and, through it, access to other schemes; PMSBY accident cover of Rs 2 lakh (death/permanent disability) for the first year.
how_to_apply: Register free at eshram.gov.in or at the nearest CSC. Helpline 14434.

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY health cover
keywords: ayushman bharat pmjay health insurance hospital treatment 5 lakh आयुष्मान
summary: Cashless hospital cover up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals for eligible families. The 2025 Union Budget announced PM-JAY cover for registered platform/gig workers; check current status before applying.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or call 14555; apply at an Ayushman Mitra desk, empanelled hospital or CSC.

keywords: pm-sym pension old age maandhan retirement 3000 पेंशन श्रम योगी

how_to_apply: Enrol at a CSC with Aadhaar and bank passbook; the first contribution is paid in cash.

title: Unpaid wages - your rights
keywords: unpaid wages salary due contractor minimum wage labour commissioner payment मजदूरी बकाया
summary: Employers must pay at least the state minimum wage on time. If wages are unpaid, keep a record (wage diary, messages, photos of work), send a written notice, then complain to the Labour Commissioner or Inspector. Under the Code on Wages, 2019 delayed or unpaid wages are an offence.
how_to_apply: Written notice first, then a complaint at the district Labour Office.

title: Safety help for women workers
keywords: women safety harassment night ride helpline 181 POSH complaint महिला सुरक्षा
summary: Call 181 (women helpline) or 112 in danger. Share live location with a trusted contact before trips, avoid isolated drop-offs at night and report the booking to the platform. Harassment at work can be reported to an Internal or Local Committee under the POSH Act.
how_to_apply: Call 181 / 112; for work harassment contact the District Local Committee.

title: Accident - first hour guide
keywords: accident crash injury insurance claim first aid hospital FIR दुर्घटना बीमा
summary: 1) Move to safety and call 112/108. 2) Do not move a badly hurt person. 3) Photograph the scene, vehicle and injuries. 4) Note witness numbers. 5) File an FIR / get a police report. 6) Inform your insurer and the platform within 24 hours and keep hospital bills for the claim.
how_to_apply: Call the insurer's claim helpline; ask the hospital for discharge summary and bills.
